page.overview:
Who is Rubina?

Rubina is a character appearing in , who is a grunt working for Explorers, and as one of Spinel's henchmen.

Rubina has sharp, confident facial features and a serious, determined expression. Her eyes are narrow with yellow irises, giving her a piercing gaze. Her eyebrows are thin, arched, and slightly angled downward toward the center, enhancing her assertive look. She has a straight, small nose and a neutral mouth set in a firm line, showing little emotion. Her hair is black with bold red streaks, styled with long bangs swept to the right side of her face and shorter strands framing her left side, while the rest is tucked neatly behind her head.

She wears a light-blue uniform with dark blue accents, similar in style to Indy's but with a few differences. Her jacket has dark blue lapels, pocket trim, and shoulder panels, along with a single dark blue button fastening it at the waist. On each upper sleeve is a white circular emblem with a dark blue center. Underneath, she wears a dark gray dress shirt, neatly buttoned. Her pants match the light-blue color of the jacket and are straight-cut, tucked into stylish dark shoes with slight heels. A prominent dark blue belt with a large gold oval buckle cinches her waist, giving her outfit a more fitted and authoritative appearance. She also wears black gloves, adding to her formal, commanding look.
